topic: Cell Wall and the Endomembrane System
title: How Does a Cell Pack and Ship? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
A crisp lettuce leaf, a wooden door and a cotton shirt all get their strength from plant cell walls. Aarav watches the canteen cook, pack and send out food and asks: what keeps a plant cell firm, and how does a cell make, pack and send out its proteins?

You will see the cell wall and what it is made of, zoom from plant tissue to the middle lamella, primary and secondary walls and plasmodesmata, then the endomembrane system step by step: rough and smooth ER. Then the Golgi apparatus with its cis and trans faces and vesicles moving through, lysosomes and vacuoles, a pause and think check, a worked example following one protein out of the cell, the exam trap, an original NEET pattern match question and a recap card.

This is Episode 64 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.

In this video:

2:31 The Golgi apparatus
3:03 Lysosomes and vacuoles
3:50 Pause and think
4:06 Worked example: follow one protein out
4:30 Exam trap: mitochondria and chloroplasts
4:51 Practice question (NEET pattern)
5:16 Recap and three questions

Next episode: Mitochondria and Plastids. One organelle burns food for energy, another catches sunlight. How?
